# Census Finds Japan’s Population Declined by More than 800,000 in Five Years

Society Family Economy

Japan’s 2020 census recorded a decline in population of more than 800,000 since the previous census in 2015. [...] At the time of the last census, according to United Nations estimates, Japan’s population ranked tenth in the world, but now it has dropped to eleventh place, overtaken by Mexico.

By prefecture, Tokyo had the largest population with 14,064,694, followed by Kanagawa with 9,240,411 and Osaka with 8,842,523. The prefecture with the smallest population was Tottori with 553,847.

answer:
Tokyo’s metropolitan prefecture (Tokyo Metropolis) has a population of **14,064,694** (as of **October 1, 2020**), which is **about 11.1%** of Japan’s total population of **126,304,543** (2020). [S11][S10]

*Supported math:* 14,064,694 ÷ 126,304,543 ≈ 0.1114 ⇒ **~11.1%**. [S11][S10]
